newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-AJAX AND FEYENOORD FANS CLASH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AJAX AND FEYENOORD FANS CLASH.

text.p: Ajax Amsterdam and Feyenoord fans armed with a variety of weapons, including knives, sticks, clubs and pickaxes, clashed on Sunday on a ring road to the north of Amsterdam, police said.
The two teams meet in the league at Ajax's Arena stadium next Sunday.

"There were about 40 Feyenoord supporters and 40 from Ajax involved on the A10 (ring road). The police moved in very quickly and there were no injuries but we closed parts of the road for some time," said a police spokesman.
He described the incident as more of a stand-off than a pitched battle.
Feyenoord were away to Volendam, some 15 kilometres north of Amsterdam, on Sunday while Ajax travelled to Graafschap Doetinchem in the east of the country.
During the Ajax-Feyenoord match in Rotterdam in November Feyenoord fans lobbed fire-bombs at the police and bombarded the Ajax team bus.
Ajax fans had pelted police with ball bearings when they arrived at Rotterdam's Central Station.
